name: Smarty Labs
storyline: A boy walks through a park until he accidentally falls though a hole into an abandoned lad where he comes across a robot that lives there. The robot tasks him into solving puzzles in the lab using a physics manipulation gun that the robot provides the boy in exchange for helping the boy get back to the surface. The robot guides him through different levels in the lab while upgrading the boy's gun with more abilities each time to progress through the levels.
summary: An indie first person puzzle platformer rage bait game that involves navigating a lab by solcing physics based puzzles. The game revolves around a boy who is out on a walk until he falls through a hole into an abandoned lab where he meets a robot that tasks him with undergoing experiments in the lab using a physics manipulation gun that creates physics anomalies that give the player different abilities. The game has 4 stages each with 10 rooms, therefore 40 levels.
